title: Norwegian Flatbread with Roasted Pickle Topping
description: A Scandinavian-inspired flatbread topped with a sweet and tangy roasted pickle mixture.
instructions: Cut the flatbread into triangles or squares.
In a small bowl, mix together the olive oil, honey, Dijon mustard, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Brush the mixture onto the flatbread pieces.
Place the flatbread on a baking sheet and bake for 5-7 minutes, or until crispy.
Meanwhile, heat the norwegian pickle in the oven for 10-12 minutes, or until caramelized.
Top each flatbread piece with a spoonful of the roasted pickle mixture.
